scenarios.title: Finnish lung pathway (synthetic)
scenarios.description: Synthetic Finnish lung-cancer pathway in one wellbeing services county, clock from first contact in primary care (nurse or GP) to start of treatment. target_days: 90 is a PROVISIONAL display target (decisions.md D20): with the clock starting at first contact in primary care, every flowchart is at 0% within the Norwegian 42 days (which counts from referral receipt). We found no Finnish national first-contact-to-treatment target; IHE2026 gives assessment within 21 days of referral, and the strategy goal is "treatment within target times". Chest-symptom presenters arrive as a Poisson stream; lung cancer is about 1.6% of them, the rest is pneumonia, COPD exacerbation, benign nodule, other benign chest conditions and self-limiting illness. Half see a nurse first (KHALIFE2025). Queues form at GP appointments, chest X-ray, specialist clinic, CT, bronchoscopy / needle biopsy, PET-CT and treatment slots. Chest X-ray misses about one in five lung cancers (HSSIB2021, BRADLEY2021); a safety net (persisting symptoms -> re-presentation weeks later) catches some of them, the rest are discharged = missed cancers.

variants.label: Suggested change
changes: Fast lane: once the hospital has handled a referral, give that patient priority in every later queue
Book a GP appointment, not a nurse, at first contact

variants.label: GPs order CT directly (alarm symptoms skip the chest X-ray; suspicious film goes to CT before referral). Needs about 2.7x the CT slots (CT demand is 7-8 a weekday against 2.6 in the baseline); with the baseline's 3 slots the CT queue grows without bound

CT and PET-CT ordered together at the specialist visit, board before sampling, sampling while treatment is booked. Orders about 2.8x as many PET-CT scans (PET demand 2.3 a weekday against 0.8), so it needs 3 PET slots a day; with 1 slot the PET queue grows without bound
Baseline plus a fast lane for non-specific presenters with a suspicious X-ray (priority, reserved clinic and CT slots, short booking leads)
Baseline order with the extra CT (8 slots) and PET-CT (3 slots) capacity that direct_ct and bundled_workup need (capacity-only control)
